title: Acetaminophen or Fluvastatin Compared to Placebo on the Transient Post-Dose Symptoms (PDS) Following an Intravenous (i.v.) Infusion of a Single Dose of Zoledronic Acid 5mg, in Post-menopausal Women With Low Bone Mass

sections.abstract:
This study will evaluate the efficacy of acetaminophen or fluvastatin in reducing the rate of occurrence and the severity of post dose symptoms that may occur during the 3 day period following a zoledronic acid infusion in post menopausal women with low bone mass.

Posted outcomes: Proportion of Patients With a Clinically Significant Increase in Oral Body Temperature or Use of Rescue Medication.. timeframe=0 - 3 days. Placebo=0.607; Acetaminophen=0.398; Fluvastatin=0.618
